findings_to_judge.finding: Waterdrop's entire revenue growth story is one line: technical service income went RMB1.8m (Q4 2024) to RMB9.4m (Q1 2025) to RMB639.6m (Q4 2025) to RMB421.0m (Q1 2026) -- so it already fell 34.2% sequentially in Q1 2026 -- while brokerage income, the actual insurance business, was RMB648.6m / RMB670.8m / RMB724.8m over the same span, i.e. +11.7% YoY against the +64.8% headline, with sales and marketing rising from 22.9% to 43.6% of revenue and net profit falling to RMB98.4m from RMB108.2m.

Huize Holding, the closest listed Chinese online life/health insurance brokerage, reported H1 2026 on 2026-08-20 with gross written premium +29.8% and first-year premium +48.7% but operating revenue up only 5.8% -- revenue per unit of premium fell from 21.1% to 17.2%, an 18.5% relative collapse in the channel take rate, in exactly the April-June window Waterdrop is about to report.

Waterdrop will report Q2 2026 with no CFO (vacant since Kangping Shi left in June 2022), no head of finance (Xiaoying Xu resigned as VP of finance and head of finance effective 2026-07-31), and a replacement audit-committee financial expert who took the seat only on 2026-07-01 after Heping Feng resigned from the audit, compensation and nominating committees -- two finance-governance exits inside 30 days, both immediately after the FY2025 20-F carrying the undisclosed RMB639.6m revenue line.

The US$50 million share repurchase authorisation expires on 2026-09-09 -- the day after this print -- with the great majority unused (cumulative buybacks moved only from US$118.1m to US$120.1m between the Q4 and Q1 releases, and the 20-F puts usage under the September 2025 programme at US$9.5m as of 2026-03-31), and Waterdrop has launched a new programme in September 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025 and declared a US$0.03/ADS cash dividend alongside both its Q2 2025 and Q4 2025 results.

WDH's NYSE Rule 802.01C 30-trading-day average closing price is $1.0263 as of 2026-09-04 (window 2026-07-27 to 2026-09-04), and the five sessions rolling out of that window closed $1.15/$1.15/$1.15/$1.14/$1.12, so the next five closes must average at least $0.984 to keep the average above $1.00 -- roughly 3.5% of cushion from the $1.02 spot, with the print the only scheduled catalyst inside that window.
